item.title: Scaling agent evaluations
item.description: How we evaluate agents at scale.
item.content:encoded:
Why agent evals are hard

Agents take many steps, call tools and change the state of the world, so a single final answer is not enough to judge whether a run went well.

We built a harness that replays thousands of tool-using trajectories in sandboxes and grades every intermediate step with rubric-based checks.

def grade(step): return rubric(step)

Results

The new evaluation suite caught regressions two weeks earlier than our previous benchmarks and reduced flaky results by more than half.

Inter-annotator agreement between the automatic graders and human reviewers reached 0.87 across all task families we tested.
